title: Malva Pudding
description: A sticky apricot jam sponge that has hot cream sauce poured over it straight from the oven and drinks all of it. Served warm, never cold.
notes: The sauce must go on while both the pudding and the sauce are hot. Cold sauce sits on top instead of soaking in.

steps.text: Beat the sugar and eggs until thick and pale, then beat in the apricot jam and melted butter.
Stir the baking soda into the milk with the white vinegar — it will froth — and fold it into the batter with the flour.
steps.tip: Work quickly once the soda and vinegar meet. The lift starts immediately.

steps.text: Pour into a buttered dish and bake until risen and deep brown.
Warm the heavy cream, butter, sugar, and hot water together until the sugar dissolves.
Prick the hot pudding all over and pour the hot sauce over it in stages, letting each addition disappear.
steps.tip: It will look like far too much liquid. It is not.

steps.text: Stand before serving so the sponge finishes absorbing.
